process.commandLine: powershell -NoProfile -Command "'sandbox PID: ' + $PID; function T($n, $h, $p) { $c = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { if ($c.ConnectAsync($h, $p).Wait(3000)) { $n + ': CONNECTED' } else { $n + ': timed out' } } catch { $n + ': BLOCKED -> ' + $_.Exception.InnerException.Message } finally { $c.Close() } }; T 'egress 1.1.1.1:443   ' '1.1.1.1' 443; T 'host loopback :18080' '127.0.0.1' 18080; $name = 'mxc-dns-probe-' + (Get-Random) + '.example.com'; 'dns probe name: ' + $name; try { [Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses($name) | Out-Null; 'dns lookup: resolved' } catch { 'dns lookup: failed -> ' + $_.Exception.InnerException.Message }; try { [Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses('www.microsoft.com') | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { 'dns www.microsoft.com: ' + $_ } } catch { 'dns www.microsoft.com: failed -> ' + $_.Exception.InnerException.Message }"
